BytesHash

Gets the hash value representing the current state of the input layout in compiled bytes.

public ulong BytesHash { get; }

Property Value

ulong

Remarks

The hash can be used to efficiently compare input layouts or detect changes. The value is unique to the layout's byte representation and may change if the layout is modified.

TextHash

Gets the hash of the shader code as text. This is a 64-bit hash value that uniquely identifies the shader code based on its textual representation. The hash is computed from the shader code and can be used to compare different shader programs or to cache compiled shaders. Note that this hash may differ across different runs of the application or on different platforms, as it is based on the text of the shader code rather than its compiled binary representation.

public ulong TextHash { get; }

Property Value

ulong

Methods

Compile(string, bool)

Compiles the shader program using the provided shader code. If the compilation is successful, the shader program will be ready for use; otherwise, an error message will be returned. The code must have the vertex and pixel shader, named VSmain and PSmain and so on. You can also have CSmain for compute shaders, which does not require other entry points.

public string? Compile(string shaderCode, bool isCompute = false)

Parameters

shaderCode string

The code of the vertex and pixel shader, named VSmain and PSmain and so on.

isCompute bool

When doing a compute shader, set to true.

Returns

string

The error message from the compilation

CompileFromFile(string, bool)

Compiles the shader program from a file specified by the provided file path. If the compilation is successful, the shader program will be ready for use; otherwise, an error message will be returned. The code must have the vertex and pixel shader, named VSmain and PSmain and so on. You can also have CSmain for compute shaders, which does not require other entry points.

public string? CompileFromFile(string filepath, bool isCompute = false)

Parameters

filepath string

The file path to the shader code, which should contain the vertex and pixel shader, named VSmain and PSmain and so on.

isCompute bool

When doing a compute shader, set to true.

Returns

string

The error message from the compilation

GetCacheBlob()

Gets a binary blob that represents the compiled shader program, which can be used for caching purposes. The blob contains all the necessary information to recreate the shader program without needing to recompile the shader code. If the shader program is not ready or if there was an error during compilation, this method may return null.

public byte[]? GetCacheBlob()

Returns

byte[]

The binary cache blob or null when not available.

GetRecommendedInputLayout()

Gets a recommended input layout instance for this shader program. This is optional and may return null if the shader program does not provide a recommended input layout.

public IShaderInputLayout? GetRecommendedInputLayout()

Returns

IShaderInputLayout

GetRecommendedInputLayoutDesc()

Gets a recommended input layout description for this shader program. Don't actually make any changes directly to this, create a copy and call SetRecommendedInputLayout(ShaderInputLayoutDesc) instead.

public ShaderInputLayoutDesc GetRecommendedInputLayoutDesc()

Returns

ShaderInputLayoutDesc

A ShaderInputLayoutDesc that describes the recommended input layout for the shader program. This is optional so it may be empty.

Remarks

The returned input layout is typically suitable for use when creating input layouts for vertex buffers that are intended to be used with this shader program. The exact structure of the layout depends on the shader's expected input signature.

LoadFromCacheBlob(byte[])

Loads a compiled shader program from a binary cache blob. This allows you to recreate a shader program without needing to recompile the shader code, which can significantly reduce loading times. The provided cache blob should be obtained from a previous call to GetCacheBlob() for the same shader program configuration. If the cache blob is valid and compatible with the current shader program, it will be loaded successfully; otherwise, an error may occur, and the shader program may not be ready for use.

public bool LoadFromCacheBlob(byte[] cacheBlob)

Parameters

cacheBlob byte[]

The binary cache blob that represents the compiled shader program. This should be obtained from a previous call to GetCacheBlob() for the same shader program configuration.

Returns

bool

true when the cache blob has been loaded.

SetRecommendedInputLayout(ShaderInputLayoutDesc)

Sets the recommended input layout for this shader program based on the shader code and its requirements. The input layout describes how vertex data should be organized and accessed by the GPU when rendering with this shader program. By setting the recommended input layout, don't have to make your own later and can tell the backend to use this one, saving you the trouble of defining it yourself.

public void SetRecommendedInputLayout(ShaderInputLayoutDesc inputLayoutDesc)

Parameters

inputLayoutDesc ShaderInputLayoutDesc

The recommended description according to you.
